title: Box execution
description:
The optional, shell-free application entry point shared by a scroll, the signed release, and box.json. Its absence means the box is intentionally library-only.

Each kind is named <runtime>-<shape>, and the runtime half must be the one the box declares: a python-script in a box whose runtime is native describes something that cannot be run, and is refused rather than guessed at.

oneOf.title: Python script
oneOf.description: Run one regular payload file with the box's own Python interpreter.

script.description: Safe path to a regular Python file inside the box.

oneOf.title: Python module
oneOf.description: Run an importable dotted module with Python's -m option.

module.description: Strict Python dotted-module name, without command-line syntax or shell fragments.

oneOf.title: Node script
oneOf.description: Run one regular payload file with the box's own Node runtime.

script.description: Safe path to a regular JavaScript file inside the box.

oneOf.title: Native binary
oneOf.description: Run a compiled executable that the box carries directly, with no interpreter in front of it. The only shape a runtime with no module system has.

kind.description: Selects direct execution of a payload file.

binary.description: Safe path to the executable inside the box. It carries the executable bit because the scroll declared it, not because the build machine happened to have it set.

defaultArgs.description: Arguments placed before caller-supplied arguments. Every item is passed directly without a shell.

payloadPath.description: A forward-slash path inside the box payload: relative, non-empty, and unable to escape the payload root.
